slice: document/window join the dispatch chain (slot-tagged listeners, virtual doc/win stations)
context: R39 diagnosed full document/window-in-chain as deep structure (12 dispatch sites + triple key). R40 implements it WITHOUT splitting the triple key: slot-tagged listener entries + virtual dispatch stations.

design.slot_tagging: listener entry gains tgt field ('doc' for document.addEventListener / 'win' for window + _globalAddEventListener / undefined = html element registration). Storage stays in the _elKey('html') triple key (postMessage/onerror/inline-handler dependencies intact).
design.virtual_stations: _dispatchWithBubble appends document/window virtual stations after the element chain (capture reverse: win -> doc -> element chain; bubble forward: element chain -> doc -> win). Each station dispatches with slot filter so listeners fire on their registration identity (currentTarget = document/window itself, not html proxy).
design.target_slot: document.dispatchEvent / window.dispatchEvent pass targetSlot ('doc'/'win'): path = [document, window] / [window]; doc is AT_TARGET once, win bubbles once; element chain empty. composedPath[0] uses the doc/win object itself.
design.detached: detached elements (handle-only / not in html subtree) skip doc/win stations (path ends at root).
design.html_target_filter: html element as target (host lifecycle __zw_dispatch_event('html', type)) filters target station to null slot — doc/win registrations fire only at their virtual stations (prevents double-fire; caught by renderer R2941/R2943 quickjs regression, fixed same round).
design.once_removal_fix: once-listener removal now filters from the original store array (slot-filtered list may be a subset copy; writing it back would drop other slots' registrations).

results.bubbles_true: 2P/5F -> 2P/3F both paths (main-path subtests incl. window->document full chain pass; remaining 3F = document.cloneNode/new Document()/createHTMLDocument deep structure)

regression.renderer_quickjs_r2941_r2943: double-fire regression caught and fixed in-round (html target station slot filter)

deferred_deep_structure: document.cloneNode(true) / new Document() / implementation.createHTMLDocument() as independent Document instances (Event-dispatch-bubbles-true/false remaining 3F each) — independent-Document infrastructure, html-compat adjacent.
